integrity.proof: self-contained algebraic parity and exhaustive support classification

scientific_limitations: All-order proof is elementary and self-contained. Two independent exhaustive tests cover only ground-set sizes 5 through 10 and sizes 1, 3 and 5. The prior 2001 paper is earlier by year than the 2003 source, but an exact first-public day for the former was not established; 2003-02-28 is the earliest day-verified source among those used. Complete 2003 publisher PDF and some older archival files were not accessible; novelty remains subject to independent expert priority review. No independent scholarly validation has occurred.
title: Connected odd domination of \(\operatorname{KG}(n,2)\): three exceptional ground-set orders
